name: Bigos
description: Sauerkraut and fresh cabbage stewed with several meats for days, reheated each time.

ayurveda.note: Soured cabbage and cured meat are both ushna.

histamine.note: Sauerkraut, cured sausage and repeated reheating over days — that is the recipe, and each step raises it.

nutrition.highlight: reheated daily, and better for it
